# Irisha Concierge

> Plan a private luxury pilgrimage to Varanasi, Ayodhya and Prayagraj with Irisha Concierge. Tailored itineraries, premium stays and chauffeur-driven transfers.

## Pilgrimage packages
- The Sacred Triangle: Three sacred cities, with flights, luxury stays, private travel and meaningful rituals coordinated by your dedicated concierge. Every day is shaped around your pace and preferences.
- Nalanda, Gaya & Bodhgaya: Nalanda, Gaya and Bodhgaya, with flights, luxury stays, private travel and meaningful rites coordinated by your dedicated concierge. Every day is shaped around your pace and preferences.

## Elite fleet
- Force Urbania (THE GROUP TRAVEL EXPERIENCE, 16-seater): More room for your people. More space to unwind. Our premium Urbania makes the time between destinations a pleasure of its own.
- Innova Crysta (TIMELESS COMFORT, Family & executive travel): A refined choice for private family journeys, airport pickups and unhurried intercity travel.
- Innova Hycross (A NEW LEVEL OF REFINEMENT, Premium family travel): Contemporary refinement for family escapes and executive transfers. Settle in and enjoy your own space.

## Holidays
- [Discover Central Vietnam](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/discover-central-vietnam/): A compact family holiday through Central Vietnam. Arrive in Da Nang for seafronts and a modern city rhythm, ride to Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge, then spend a day among Hoi An’s lanterns, temples and riverside streets. The pace leaves room for beaches, Fantasy Park and evenings together.
- [Romantic Vietnam Odyssey](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/romantic-vietnam-odyssey/): A honeymoon-paced journey through north and south. Begin in Hanoi’s lakes and Old Quarter, sail overnight through Halong Bay, then fly south for Saigon’s energy, river evenings and a day on the Mekong if you wish. Designed for couples who want iconic Vietnam without a group timetable.
- [Maldives Couple Escape](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/maldives-couple-escape/): A couple’s island holiday with one resort stay. We shortlist properties for lagoon, privacy and dining — overwater or beach villa — then coordinate flights into Malé, the resort transfer and any spa or sunset-cruise add-ons you want.
- [Vietnam Family Voyage](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/vietnam-family-voyage/): A north-to-centre family holiday with a night on Halong Bay. Two nights in Hanoi ease everyone in, the cruise breaks the cities, then Da Nang and Hoi An close the week with beach time and a lantern evening children remember.
- [Thailand Couple Escape](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/thailand-couple-escape/): A honeymoon-paced Thailand: city first, sea second. Three nights in Bangkok for temples, river evenings and dining, then fly south for Phuket beaches and one shared or private island day. Built for two, without a group timetable.
- [Thailand Family Circuit](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/thailand-family-circuit/): A classic India-to-Thailand family circuit. Two nights in Bangkok ease everyone in, Pattaya adds a coastal pause and a park or sanctuary day, then Phuket closes the week with beaches. Hotel rooms and transfers are planned for families, not only couples.
- [Bali Couple Retreat](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/bali-couple-retreat/): A couple’s Bali with two stays, not a hotel every night. Ubud for rice terraces, temples and quieter evenings; Seminyak for beach clubs, sunsets and a last stretch by the Indian Ocean. Private transfers keep the days yours.
- [Bali Family Getaway](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/bali-family-getaway/): Two stays so you are not packing every morning. Ubud introduces temples and terraces at a child’s pace; Nusa Dua or a similar resort coast closes the week with a beach and a proper pool. Private transfers throughout.
- [Dubai Couple Escape](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/dubai-couple-escape/): A couple’s city break with one stay so you are not changing hotels. Mornings can be empty; evenings take the fountain, a dhow or the desert. Built around how you like a city — not a coach circuit.
- [Dubai Family Holiday](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/dubai-family-holiday/): A family Dubai that does not try to do every park. One hotel near the attractions you actually want; a desert evening most families enjoy; the rest left open for the pool, fountain or a single park day.
- [Singapore Couple Escape](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/singapore-couple-escape/): A couple’s long weekend in one walkable city. Mornings for a neighbourhood — Tiong Bahru, Kampong Gelam or Chinatown — evenings for the bay. Parks and tickets only when you want them.
- [Singapore Family Holiday](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/singapore-family-holiday/): A short family city break. One hotel so you are not packing; Gardens for a shared evening; Sentosa or a wildlife park only if that is the trip you want. Daily load can be lightened for younger children.
- [Sri Lanka Couple Circuit](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/sri-lanka-couple-circuit/): A couple’s island circuit: rock fortress and cave temples in the cultural triangle, a night near Kandy, tea country around Ella, then the south coast. Private vehicle between stays; the train is added when seats exist.
- [Sri Lanka Family Circuit](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/sri-lanka-family-circuit/): Culture first, beach second — short enough for school holidays. Pidurangala or a lower viewpoint can replace the full Sigiriya climb. Three coastal nights let everyone recover before the flight home.
- [Mauritius Couple Escape](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/mauritius-couple-escape/): A couple’s island week with one check-in. We shortlist west- or north-coast resorts for lagoon, privacy and dining, then coordinate the airport run and any catamaran or Chamarel day you want.
- [Mauritius Family Holiday](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/mauritius-family-holiday/): A family island week with one check-in. We shortlist resorts that actually work for children — beach entry, pool, connecting rooms — then add at most one organised day so the rest can stay empty.
- [Switzerland Couple Escape](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/switzerland-couple-escape/): A couple’s alpine week with two stays. Lucerne for the lake and old town; Interlaken or a nearby village for high peaks. Trains, not coaches. One mountain day is included as quoted; the rest can stay empty.
- [Switzerland Family Holiday](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/switzerland-family-holiday/): A family Switzerland that does not try to cover the whole country. Two stays, trains children can sit through, and one mountain day. The rest can be lakes and playgrounds.
- [Japan Couple Odyssey](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/japan-couple-odyssey/): A couple’s first Japan without a tour-bus timetable. Three nights in Tokyo for neighbourhoods and evenings, one night in Hakone for onsen and a Fuji view if the weather allows, then Kyoto for temples and Gion after dark.
- [Japan Family Holiday](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/japan-family-holiday/): Two cities, two hotels. Tokyo has the teamLab-or-Disney day if you want one; Kyoto keeps temple mornings short. Shinkansen between them. Built so younger children are not asked to do Hakone as well.
- [Kenya Couple Safari](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/kenya-couple-safari/): A couple’s first Kenya: one Nairobi night to recover from the flight, then a Mara lodge or tented camp with morning and afternoon drives. Built for two, with dietary needs sent to camp before you land.
- [Kenya Family Safari](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/kenya-family-safari/): A first family safari that does not pretend every child wants a 5 a.m. start. We shortlist Mara camps that take your children’s ages, keep a Nairobi night for the long flight, and let drives end when the youngest has had enough.
- [Sri Lanka Couple Escape](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/sri-lanka-couple-escape/): A compact couple’s Sri Lanka: two nights on Bentota beach, then Colombo for a last dinner and an easy airport morning. Built for a long weekend or a first look at the island.
- [Sri Lanka Honeymoon Circuit](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/sri-lanka-honeymoon-circuit/): A couple’s Sri Lanka with three stays: two nights by Kandy lake and the Temple of the Tooth, two on Bentota beach, then Colombo before you fly. Culture, then sea — without a hotel every night.
- [Sri Lanka Eternal Romance](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/sri-lanka-eternal-romance/): A longer couple’s trail: two nights in Kandy, a night among tea estates, three unhurried nights on the west coast, then Colombo. Private vehicle between stays; the train is added when seats exist.
- [Sri Lanka Family Escape](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/sri-lanka-family-escape/): A short family Sri Lanka: two nights on a west-coast beach the children can use, then Colombo for an easy airport morning. Built for school-holiday weekends.
- [Sri Lanka Heritage Family](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/sri-lanka-heritage-family/): A heritage-led family week: three nights near Sigiriya so the fortress morning is not rushed, two in Kandy by the lake, then Colombo. Pidurangala or a lower viewpoint can replace the full climb.
- [Sri Lanka Island Family](https://irisha.co.in/holidays/sri-lanka-island-family/): A fuller family island: fortress and Kandy first, tea country and Ella, a Yala morning, then two nights on Bentota to recover. Stays are short in the middle; the beach close is not.

## Services
- [Holidays & Tours](https://irisha.co.in/services/holidays-tours/): From a quiet escape to a multi-city holiday, we curate your itinerary, stays, transfers and experiences around your pace and preferences.
- [Visa Services](https://irisha.co.in/services/visa-services/): Get destination-specific document guidance and application coordination. Visa approval and processing times are determined by the relevant embassy or consulate.
- [Hotel Reservations](https://irisha.co.in/services/hotel-reservations/): Share your destination, dates, room preferences and budget. We’ll help select and reserve a stay suited to your journey, with inclusions confirmed before booking.
- [Flight Bookings](https://irisha.co.in/services/flight-bookings/): We help coordinate flight options with your itinerary, including preferred timings and connections. Fares, baggage and change conditions are confirmed before ticketing.
- [Events & Live Music](https://irisha.co.in/services/events-live-music/): From intimate celebrations to live music experiences, tell us your occasion, location, guest count and mood. We’ll shape the arrangements around your vision.
- [Cruise Bookings](https://irisha.co.in/services/cruise-bookings/): We help you choose and book Cordelia Cruises sailings, from a long weekend at sea to a week among islands. Cabin category, itinerary and onboard inclusions are confirmed in writing before you reserve.
